# TASK #1 (FORAC): FRAGORD 1 to IIIAC Change of Responsibility and Retirement Ceremony 2026

**Affected Unit/Staff:** HHBn, 3-16 FAR, 6-56 ADAR
**NLT Dates:** 06 AUG 26
**BLUF:** This FRAGORD retasks the Salute Battery from 1-82 FA to 3-16 FAR.

## 1. SITUATION
The 1st Cavalry Division Artillery provides support to the IIIAC Change of Responsibility and Retirement Ceremony IHO CSM John P. McDwyer 06 0900 AUG 26 at Fort Hood, TX. The IIIAC Commanding General will be the reviewing officer for the ceremony.

## 2. EXECUTION

### a. Concept of Operations
1st Cavalry Division provides support for the IIIAC Change of Responsibility and Retirement Ceremony IHO CSM John P. McDwyer 06 0900 AUG 26.

### b. Tasks to Subordinate Units

#### 3-16 FAR
1. Provide salute battery with enough ammunition to support COR ceremony 060900 AUG26 and Retirement Ceremony 06 1300 AUG 26 and all rehearsals and ceremony.
2. Provide (1) M109 Paladin as a static display. Be emplaced NLT 05 1200 AUG 26.

#### HHBN
1. **Honor Guard:** Provide Honor Guard for cake cutting detail.
2. **Band:** Provide full Band for the COR Ceremony 06 0900 AUG 26 and Retirement Ceremony 06 1300 AUG 26.

#### 6-56 ADAR
1. Provide one (1) STOUT Stryker with crew as a static display. Be emplaced NLT 05 1200 AUG 26.

### c. Coordinating Instructions
1. Units are required to be at the staging area NLT 0815.
2. Inclement weather rehearsal will be conducted at III Armored Corps East Atrium TBD.
    1. Sub-item requiring roman numeral rendering (i, ii, iii...)

## 3. COMMAND AND SIGNAL

### a. Command
1. Reviewing Officer: LTG Kevin Admiral
2. Command Sergeant Major: CSM John McDwyer

### b. Signal
1. The POC for this order is CPT Adam Isakson at adam.j.isakson.mil@army.mil.
